Subject: 1:1 Request — Want to Check In on This Quarter

Hi Alex,

I'd like to schedule a 1:1 this week to talk honestly about how things are going. I want to be upfront: I have some concerns about this quarter that I want to work through with you.

Here's what I'm seeing:

**Delivery timelines:** The Persona V3 integration landed 13 days past the March 15 deadline, and the evaluation pipeline (due April 1) is still in progress. These are significant misses, and I don't recall us flagging risks early on either one.

**Code reviews:** A few team members have raised that your reviews have been lighter than usual — approvals without substantive feedback on complex PRs. That's a change from the standard you've set in the past.

**Communication:** You've missed two standups without a heads-up, and there have been several stretches of 3+ hours unresponsive on Teams. The team notices, and it affects coordination.

I want to name clearly: this doesn't match the Alex I saw lead the V2 launch, mentor Maya and Jordan, and earn an Exceeds rating last year. That's exactly why I want to have this conversation — something has shifted, and I'd rather understand what's going on than make assumptions.

This isn't a disciplinary meeting. The goal is to figure out what's happening, whether there's something I or the team can do differently, and agree on a path forward together. If there are things outside work affecting you, you don't owe me details, but I want you to know there's room for that conversation too.

Can you grab 45 minutes on my calendar before Friday? Happy to do whatever setting works best for you — office, walk, video call.

Thanks, Alex. I mean it when I say I want to help sort this out.

— [Your name]
